scenes.myth: You only use 10% of your brain
scenes.fact: Almost every region of your brain is active every day

points.text: Simple tasks light up large areas

demoScript: You only use ten percent of your brain. You've heard this a million times. It's a myth. Brain scans show that almost every region is active during a normal day. Even simple tasks light up large areas. And damage to almost any part causes problems. So no hidden ninety percent. Busted.
